description: Get the stored agenticness dimensions, evidence and evaluation version for one tool, when available. The current rubric (v3.1) has 9 dimensions (action capability, autonomy, planning, adaptation, state continuity, reliability, interoperability, safety, operator sovereignty) scored 0-4 each (max 36). Use this for deep analysis of one tool's AI agent capabilities. For a quick score, get_listing includes the overall score. For comparing scores, use compare_listings.
name: get_agenticness_details
